name: contact_sheet
description: Tile sampled frames of a composited project into one image, each labelled with its time. No video encode: one sample_frame per time. --every covers the whole project on a grid; --at lists exact times (repeatable), e.g. 12 consecutive frame times for a frame strip. A small --tile-width (360) gives a phone-size view.

output.description: {path, times, cols, tile_width, frames?: [abs paths in time order, only when frames-dir is set]}

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: every
params.description: Sample every N seconds across the project (must be > 0; not combined with --at; capped at 120 samples)

params.name: frames-dir
params.description: Keep the sampled frame PNGs here (f_0000.png...) instead of discarding them, and report their paths
